tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// thang rgyal lugs kyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sgom lung mchod chog dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir grub thob chen pos rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po las dngos su gsan/ las can gyi gdul bya sangs rgyas kyi nye lam la bkod pa'i lam zab mo bla ma'i sgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro/ ma nam mkha' ma'i gsol 'debs yang rtse gcig pas brgya stong mang du byas rjes/ tshogs drug sgyu ma'i lam chad pa'i rang rig rjen pa'i mdangs der/ skad cig yid 'gyus la rang gang du 'dug pa'i gnas khang bla ma mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing khams 'og min stug po bkod pa'i gnas mchog tu shar ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ chos thams cad rtsa ba gcig tu 'dus pa'i brdar/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid chos sku rdo rje 'chang yab yum nam mkha' sprin gyis ma gos pa ltar sngo la dwangs pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol mar 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad gzi 'od 'bar ba/ yab rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ yum pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khyud pa/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams snang zhing*/ sku las spros pa'i 'od zer gcig gis kyang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su khyab pa/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid can de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ dbang bskur dang*/ sems ngo sprad pa man chad nas/ ka kha yig ngo bstan pa yan chad kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma/ gnod sbyin nor lha/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs skyabs yul khyad par can thams cad spyan drangs nas thim pas bla ma kun 'dus/

yi dam kun 'dus/ mkha' 'gro kun 'dus/ chos skyong kun 'dus/ gsol ba btab na smos ci/ mtshan tsam thos pas kyang ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs shing*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid can du snying nas nges shes bskyed cing mos gus dung dung pa byas la/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa chig chod du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ltos med bzhi la rang rgyud 'byongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sku bzhi'i rten 'brel tshe 'dir 'grigs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du/ stan thog 'di nyid du/ phyi dus la ma ltos par mngon sum du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas bla ma'i dpral mgrin snying ga nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum byon/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang gong ma gsum thob par mos/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag cag mos pa dag pa'i gdul bya la// lus ngag yid la sku gsung thugs zhugs te/ myur du khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// bla ma rang la thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ dam tshig nyams chag thams cad gsos par mos/ de nas 'pho ba thar pa'i sgo 'byed bsgom ste/ rang lus bum nang lta bu'i nang nas rang sems bla mar shar ba bya 'phur gyis spyi bo tshangs sgo'i rgya dkar nas rgyangs te thon/ dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par bsam/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs bya'o// / grub chen thang stong rgyal pos rdo rje 'chang las dngos su gsan pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ grub chen lcags zam pa chen po/ stag lung pa bde chen dpal bzang*/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byor/ 'jam mgon kun dga' grol mchog ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ rje dpon ngag dbang nyi ma/ kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ ra smad mkhan chen ngag dbang bsod nams mchog grub/ bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ des bdag pad+ma bshes gnyen la'o// ༈ /grub chen thang stong rgyal po dang*// mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dbyer med pa'i// rdo rje 'chang la gus btud nas// mnyes byed mchod pa'i cho ga bri// de la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas gtsang mar rgyan dang yod byad kyi bkod pas spras pa'i gung du tshogs kyi rten bris sku la sogs pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i spyan sngar/ maṇ+ḍal/ chu gnyis nyer spyod gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod rdzas ci tsam 'byor pa dag gtsang zhing dag la ser snas ma spags pa bsham mo// dngos gzhi ngag 'don la/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsangs chu la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig tsam gyis byin brlabs la 'thor te sngags de nyid kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal med khang brtsegs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bzang zhing dge ba nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mos byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro ni/

ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes nyer gcig la sogs pa ci nus dang*/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas tshogs rten sgrub pa ni/ tshogs drug sgyu ma'i lam chad pa'i rang rig rjen pa'i mdangs der/ skad cig yid 'gyus la rang gang du 'dug pa'i gnas khang bla ma mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i zhing khams 'og min stug po bkod pa'i gnas mchog tu shar ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ chos thams cad rtsa ba gcig tu 'dus pa'i brdar/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid chos sku rdo rje 'chang yab yum nam mkha' sprin gyis ma gos pa ltar sngo la dwangs pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol mar 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad gzi 'od 'bar ba/ yab rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ yum pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khyud pa/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams snang zhing*/ sku las spros pa'i 'od zer gcig gis kyang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su khyab pa/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid can de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ de dag las 'od 'phros/ dbang bskur dang*/ sems ngo sprad pa man chad nas/ ka kha yig ngo bstan pa yan chad kyi bla ma yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ gnod sbyin nor lha/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs skyabs yul khyad par can thams cad spyan drangs nas thim pas bla ma kun 'dus/ yi dam kun 'dus/ mkha' 'gro kun 'dus/ chos skyong kun 'dus/ gsol ba btab na smos ci/ mtshan tsam thos pas kyang ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs shing*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god par mdzad pa'i bdag nyid can du snying nas nges shes bskyed cing mos gus dung dung pa byas la/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan sku// bde stong zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// rigs kun khyab bdag zhabs la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// dngos grub kun gyi rin chen gter// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings shes rab pha rol phyin// zag med bde chen sgyu ma'i sku// bde gshegs thams cad skyed pa'i yum// rdo rje btsun mo la phyag 'tshal// zhes dang*/ kun rdzob bden pa la phyag 'tshal// don dam khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bden gnyis dbyer med la phyag 'tshal// rdo rje'i sku khyod la phyag 'tshal// sku dang gsung dang thugs ni dag /sku ni gdod nas nam mkha'i sku// rnam par mi rtog dmigs pa med// rang bzhin med pa khyod phyag 'tshal// dge dang mi dge'i rnam rtog dang*// yid la byed dang sems pa med// rang bzhin gyis ni nam mkha'i tshul// rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba'i sgrub pas 'khor gyur pa'i// phung po lnga ni rnam par dag

/sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bo nyid// nam mkhar gnas pa khyod phyag 'tshal// yongs su mi shes 'khor ba yi// rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i lus can phyir// yongs shes skye ba 'dzin pa yi// ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag dang mi rtag sogs rnams la// rtag dang mi rtag sogs rnams kyis// rnam dag lam ston la mkhas pa// rdo rje slob dpon khyod phyag 'tshal// rang gi sde dang gzhan gyi sde// lta ba'i rims kyis btab pa yi// nad pa rnams ni gso mdzad pa// sman pa'i rgyal po khyod phyag 'tshal// sna tshogs rnam par rtog pa yi// 'dam gyis ma gos gtsang ba'i sku// 'od gsal bar ni ngang gis gnas// pad+ma chen po khyod phyag 'tshal/ zhes pa nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bstod pa/ phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ rnam dag sku ni skyon bral 'khrul pa med// phun tshogs gsung dbyangs shes bya ma lus khyab// zab dang rgya che'i de nyid mkhyen pa'i thugs// rdo rje gsum dngos dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa gtan nas spangs// dag pa gnyis ldan yon tan thams cad rdzogs// rang gzhan don gyur sku gnyis mngon mdzad pa// 'khor 'das ma lus sprul par mdzad la 'dud// g.yo med sems kyis bsten na skad cig la// byin gyis brlabs pas bla med byang chub lam// yang na 'dod pa mchog dang thar pa yi// dam pa nges par sbyin mdzad khyod la 'dud// lhan skyes zung 'jug srid gsum bde chen dngos// dmigs med thugs rjes khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan zad mi mnga'// chos dbyings rnam dag g.yo med khyod la 'dud// nyid kyi ye shes gcig gi rang snang las// ma lus rgyal ba sras bcas sprin spro ba// bden pa gnyis kyi rnam thar tshad mi mnga'// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor 'dud// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad smug nag khro bo'i sku// lta ba'i gding ldan brtul zhugs spyod pa skyong*// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon// o rgyan lung bstan skyes mchog sprul pa'i sku// thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/

mdog bzang dbyibs legs tshims pa'i dri bsung can// man+dā ra dang ut+pal ku mud sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i me tog kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ rgyu bzang mnams na zhim pa'i dri ngad can// a ga ru dang tsan+dan sbrul snying sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i bdug spos kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ mun sel dngos kun gsal ba'i gzi brjid can// sgron ma nyi zla lus kyi 'od la sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i snang gsal kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ dri zhim byug na bde ba'i reg mchog kun// ga bur gla rtsi mnoms pa'i dri la sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i dri mchog kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ mdog bzang myangs na bde ba'i ro bcud can// 'bras chan ka ra rgya gtar khu ba sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i zhal zas kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra nai wi d+yā pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ don zab thos na snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can// rnga chen dung dang pheg rdob rgyud mangs sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i sil snyan kun// skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje sku thob shog /oṃ āḥgu ru badz+ra dha ra sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bar 'dir maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma spyi mthun rgyas pa dang*/ bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog /dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas// gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes// phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan// rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter dang brgyad// ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi khyab// dga' dang spro ba skyed pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di// don gnyis bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// brtson pa'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbul bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun spangs nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma'ang 'bul/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dam pa dang*// blon po glang po rta mchog dmag dpon ste// rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dpag med kyang*// mngon par sprul nas bla ma mchog la 'bul// ral gri pags pa skye tshal khang khyim dang*// gzims cha gos dang mchil l+h+wam rin po che// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bde ster ma// me long pi wang spos khang bza' btung snod// ras phran bzang dang pad+ma bhañdza naṃ// cang te'u sgra sgrog kha ṭ+wāṃ la brten ma// dkar sngo ser dang dmar dang ljang ba'i gzugs// gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri ldan bcud ldan ma// bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma// nam mkha' gang bas bla ma lha tshogs mchod// bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ma// pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// rgod dang sgeg dang glu len gro gar mkhan// me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma// gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// rdo rje rig ma dga' bas rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang*// reg na bde ba lha yi gos// mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang*// glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog

/dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i me tog dang*// dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i mchog /bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod// bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul// gser dngul mu tig bai ḍūr+ya// rin chen zhing rnams bkang nas 'bul// dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar// margad bye ru dzam+bu'i gser// zla shel rin chen bdun gyi ri// zhing gi rdul snyed 'bul bar bgyi// ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga// dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum// me tog kar+ṇ-i ka ra dang*// mā li ka dang yu thi ka /me tog ka ra wī ra yang*// bsam gtan stobs kyis khyod la 'bul// mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri// pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang*// rna rgyan dang ni gdu bu dang*// mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang*// gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs// dbu rgyan dar dbyangs do shal bcas// rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser// dkar dang gnag dang ser skya dang*// de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*// me tog phreng ba du ma dang*// bla bre dag las dar dpyangs pa'i// mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes// de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis// rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya// gser ni brgya stong du ma dang*// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang*// glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang*// chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid// bran pho bran mo sring mo dang*// blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis// bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bgyi// bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni// dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso// nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing*// bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga// shes rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thabs shes lhan cig sbyor ba las// rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa'i// zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa// gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par bgyi// zhes mchod pa'i tshogs phul nas/

bstod pa ni/ rigs kun bdag nyid thog ma tha ma med// dngos gcig brtan g.yo kun khyab zung du 'jug /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde chen ye shes sku// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod// spros pa kun bral stong nyid sangs rgyas sa// rdo rje btsun mo'ibha ga gsang ba'i dbyings// chos 'byung thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du// gdod nas mngon byang chub la= /gnyis med g.yo ba med dang ris med dang*// 'dod dang mchog tu mi 'gyur 'dod chags che// dngos dang dngos po med pa zad pa dang*// ye shes dang ni sems dpa' kun tu bzang*// nyon mongs med dang nyon mongs chen po dang*// lhan skyes dpal ldan byang sems thig le 'dzin// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje dang*// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rnal 'byor mtshan// rnam grangs du mar ldan la= stong nyid snying rje dbyer med mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba chen po yod med mtha' bzhi las// rnam grol bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// don dam ye shes sku la= shes dang shes bya gcig gyur spros pa'i mtha'// kun las rab 'das rgyu 'bras ma lus pa// ye shes gcig gis gcig car gzigs gyur pa// dpe bral chos kyi sku la= stong nyid sgra brnyan shar ba'i nyin mor byed// nges pa lnga ldan sku dang zhing khams ni// snang la rang bzhin ma grub mkha' ltar khyab// longs spyod yongs su rdzogs la= bzo skye mchog sogs dag dang ma dag pa'i// gzugs brnyan pad+ma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// gang la gang 'dul ston la= sna tshogs gzugs dang rnam pa thams cad gsung*// mi 'gyur bde ba rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// stong nyid zung 'jug gsang ba bsam mi khyab// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor= rigs drug bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*// de nyid bcu drug rigs brgya mtha' yas rigs// gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad pa// rigs kun khyab bdag de la=

chos rnams kun la nye ring med par khyab// 'gro khams zad med rjes su 'dzin pa la// 'phel 'grib mi mnga' rtag par bzhugs nas su// rtsol med don chen sgrub la= gzhi dus rang bzhin 'od gsal ngo bo nyid// lam dus zag med bde stong rnal 'byor gyis// bral 'bras dag pa gnyis kyi mthar thug pa// spangs pa chen po de la= sgyu ma rmi lam pra phab brgyad bzhin du// ji snyed shes bya rtog bral ma 'khrul gzigs// chos can ji lta ba nyid mngon gyur pa'i// rtogs pa chen po de la= nam mkha' ji srid 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// don rnams 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa yi// dmigs med thugs rje chad pa med par 'jug /sems dpa' chen po de la= sa chu me rlung nam mkha' nyi zla dang*// rnam par shes pa sgrib bral dag pa yi// mtha' yas stobs dang nam yang skyon med sogs// yon tan brgyad ldan de la= rtag pa dang ni mi gdung rab tu bsil// gcig pu 'gyur med bde ldan dri ma med// dga' dang rtag tu mnyam 'jog yid dwang ba// ro myang brgyad dang ldan la= /bsam gyis mi khyab sku gsung thugs ldan cing*// rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas gnas skabs kun tu khyab// gnas gyur don sgrub byang chub skyed mdzad pa// dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan la= /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde ba che// rang bzhin ma mchis snying rjes yongs su gang*// sku dang ye shes mi 'chad mi 'gog pa'i// yan lag bdun dang ldan la= /gzugs phra reg pa yang zhing kun tu khyab// yang dag thob brnyes rab gsal brtan dang ldan// dbang phyug chen po 'dod rgur sgyur bar mdzad// khyad 'phags brgyad ldan de la= /rang bzhin med cing rang rig 'phel ba dang*// 'grib pa ma mchis rnam par mi rtog par// dngos po kun gyi gzugs brnyan snang ba yi// zab pa'i ye shes ldan la= /bsod nams ye shes de yi spyod yul snang*// chos kun la dmigs thams cad rnam pas 'jug

/kun nas thams cad don spyod phrin las te// rgya che'i ye shes rdzogs la= /yul dang dus la nye ring ma mchis shing*// ngo bo dbyer med de nyid tha mi dad// chos kun mi rtog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pas// khyab pa'i ye shes brnyes la= /rgyun mi 'chad cing 'gog pa'i chos mi mnga'// phra rab rdul dang 'gyur ba gtan nas spangs// rgyal sras kyis kyang bsam pa'i yul las 'das// rtag pa'i ye shes ldan la= /kha sbyor sku dang 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// rnam pa snying rje rtog pa'i nye sbyor thim// rlung 'gag zhu bde mngon gyur byang chub sems// mi 'gyur bde ba rdzogs la= /stong nyid las skyes las snang sdug bsngal 'gog /gar yang phyin cing g.yo med rlung sems gzugs// shes bya mi 'gal mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sku// rang 'dra'i sprin phung 'phro la= /gnyis ka ma yin mi rtog chos kun gyi// rang bzhin la zhugs dag pa rab 'byams snang*// kun tu don mdzad go 'phang mi g.yo ba// zung 'jug yan lag rdzogs la= /ye shes gcig gis chos kun sgrib med gzigs// shes bya mnyam nyid ji snyed ma 'dres rtog /gdul bya 'dul mkhyen kun la rnam mi rtog /ye shes lnga dang ldan la= /stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos// bco brgyad skye la thugs rje chen po mnga'// zag med ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig sogs// chos sku'i yon tan rdzogs la= /mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu dang*// gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu la sogs pa// gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis po yi// yon tan 'byung gnas de la= /rtsol med lhun grub rgyun gyis rtag pa yis// 'gro kun lam stegs la 'god lam du gzhug /nges legs mthar phyin mdzad pa'i phrin las ni// gang 'dul mkha' dang mnyam la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag kyang srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas par// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dngos kun khyab pa'i bdag

/zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub nas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor rtag spyod shog ༈ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje// grub thob rgya mtsho'i 'khor los sgyur// tshe dbang mnga' brnyes lcags zam pa// thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos// gcig chog rgyal po skyabs kyi phul// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// snyigs dus slob dpon gzugs su 'phrul// bsam mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa can// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// khams dbang mos pa'i bye brag ltar// gsang gsum rnam thar sna tshogs ston// thabs mkhas thugs rje che mnga' ba'i// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// nyes pa'i skyon rnams rab tu zad// legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rdzogs// rgyal ba sras bcas skyed mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro sgrol// gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs stsol// gus pas brten na 'dod rgu 'byung*// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// rtsa brgyud bla ma rin po che// 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skyabs kyi mchog tu gzung bar bgyi// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can gyis// rdul snyed lus dang bstod pa'i ngag /yid ni rtse gcig gus btud de// phyag 'os khyod la phyag bgyi'o// kun bzang rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin// sgo gsum dge rtsa dang bcas pa// nam mkha' lta bu'i blos bzung ste// mchod 'os rnams la rtag tu mchod// thog med sgrib pa chen po dang*// bcas pa'i kha na ma tho sogs// nongs pa snying nas 'gyod bshags na// 'gro ba'i mgon pos tshangs pa stsol// skyes mchog rnams kyi rnam par thar// ngo mtshar bla na med pa dang*// srid zhi'i legs spyad ci mchis la// dga' zhing gus pas yi rang ngo*// rigs dang mthun pa'i chos sgo dang*// khyad par sras bcas rgyal ba kun// bgrod pa gcig pa'i 'khor lo yis// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gsol// chos sku rgyun gyis rtag pa'i phyir// gzugs sku 'char nub mi ston par// mngon sum dbang po'i spyod yul du// rdo rje lta bur bzhugs su gsol// bsod nams 'di dang 'gro kun gyi// dge rtsa thun mong nyid byas te// bla ma'i gsang gsum mdzad par bcas// tshe gcig kho nas 'grub phyir bsngo// chos kyi rgyal po sras bcas kyi// thugs rje'i phyag gis yongs bzung ste// lam gyi mngon rtogs mthar phyin nas// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog

/bla ma las gzhan rgyal med pas// nam yang mi mnyes ma gyur cing*// sgo gsum zhabs tog dgu phrug gis// mnyes pa kho na sgrub nus shog /rtag tu dgyes pas byin rlobs shing*// thugs yid dbyer med 'dres nas su// spang rtogs bum pa gang byo zhing*// bdag gi rgyud la 'pho bar shog /rnam thar ji bzhin rtogs pa dang*// gsung gi gsang ba ma lus pa// stsal nas legs par 'dzin nus shing*// dar rgyas byed pa'i skal ldan shog /rdo rje theg pa'i rigs su skye// bla mas rjes bzung dam tshig 'chang*// rdo rje dril bu mi 'bral bar// ye shes yangs pa'i gar byed shog /rdo rje'i gsang ba 'dzin pa dang*// blang dor bral ba'i don rtogs nas// brtul zhugs phyogs med grub pa yis// 'jig rten sgron me gcig gyur shog /gzhan yang dpal dang dbang phyug dang*// nad med pa dang rdo rje'i tshe// chos mthun 'byor pa rab rgyas shing*// bstan pa phyogs brgyar spel byed shog /tshe 'dir mchog dngos ma grub na// 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs drung du// skad cig tsam gyis skye bar shog /bzang ngan bar ma'i 'brel thogs kun// sgrib pa gnyis po rab bsal nas// snang ba mtha' yas zhing khams der// sprul pa dus mas 'dren nus shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rnam par thar// ma lus bdag gis myur 'grub ste// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro sgrol ba'i// ded dpon khyod dang mtshungs par shog /zab mo bla ma'i rim pa yis// tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar sbyor ba// rdo rje 'chang gis rab gsungs pa'i// bden pas smon lam kun 'grub shog /ces yan lag bdun pas bsag sbyang byas te/ gong gi bstod pa gsol 'debs su kha bsgyur ba dang*/ bdud dpung 'joms mdzad sogs nas/ thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas lung bstan brtson 'grus bzang po'i zhabs// rgya bod yul gru kun tu brtul zhugs kyi// spyod mdzad thang stong rgyal por snyan par grags// ur+yān gnyis pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sku gsung thugs rten chu la lcags zam sogs// rnam par dkar ba'i dge tshogs dpag med kyis// sngon med nyi ma gsar pa'i dge mtshan can// grub chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mgon khyod gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// chos mthun tshe dpal bsod nams rab rgyas te// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs gyur nas// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces gsol 'debs ci nus bya/ tshogs mchod dang*/ gtor 'bul spro na 'dir rigs mthun 'jug bde sbyar zhing gang ltar/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ yid la 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rin po che// mgon po khyod la zhu zhing gsol ba ni// phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan dam pa'i chos// thos bsam sgrub pas rgyas par mdzad du gsol// thar pa'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen rnams// sku la snyun med phrin las rab rgyas shing*// rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i bde la 'god par mdzad du gsol// dam chos sgrub la brtson pa thams cad kyis// zab lam bla ma'i mos gus mthar phyin nas// spang rtogs mthar son bla ma'i sa thob ste// gzhan phan tshad med 'grub par mdzad du gsol// de ma thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du'ang*// bla ma mchog gis rtag tu rjes 'dzin cing*// lus dang longs spyod dge bas mnyes byas te// brtse bas byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol// zhes spyir 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab cing*/ bye brag tu gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab pa ni/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la dbang bzhi'i rtogs pa chig chod du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ltos med bzhi la rang rgyud 'byongs par byin= sku bzhi'i rten 'brel tshe 'dir 'grogs par byin= phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du 'grub par byin= don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du/ stan thog 'di nyid du/ phyi dus la ma ltos par mngon sum du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas bla ma'i dpral mgrin snying ga nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum byon/

rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang gong ma gsum thob par mos/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag cag mos pa dag pa'i gdul bya la// lus ngag yid la sku gsung thugs zhugs te// myur du khyod rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dang bdag gi lus// dbyer med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i ci gsung bsgrub pa dang*// gsung ngag dbyer med gsung gi rdo rjer shog /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin pa dag /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs// bla ma dgyes pa'i bya ba kun bsgrubs nas// mdzad pa phrin las mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs// mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /nongs pa bshags pa ni/ yig brgya brjod la/ bdag ni mi shes bag med dbang gyur pas// ma rig nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gang bgyis pa// brtse ldan khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can gyis bzod par gsol// bsdu rim ni/ skyabs mchog khyed ni 'gro ba'i don rab mdzad// chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba mi mnga' yang*// gzugs sku bdag gi lus la rab bskyod nas// brtse ba chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ dam tshig nyams chag thams cad gsos/ rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gyur/ ces bzo med kyi ngang du yun ring mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba na/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/

thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgrengs pa yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan te// snying gi chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod bgyid cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// sogs dang*/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// sogs theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab cing*/ mdo rgyud las byung ba'i bkra shis ci rigs pa dang*/ grub chen nyid kyi gsung bkra shis yin lugs ma sogs brjod pas dge legs su bya'o// zhes pa'ang sgrub thabs rin po che kun las btus pa'i zhal skong du rtsa ba rdo rje 'chang dngos kyis rje grub thob chen por dngos su gnang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ shangs lugs kyi bla ma mchod pa'i cho gas khog phub ste blo gter dbang pos legs par bsdebs pa'i dge bas bdag sogs 'gro kun bla ma'i lam gyis grol bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
